notes.title: 0.5.01 - Optimization Pass, AI Tweaks, Class work
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! Been super busy these last few months. I've been doing some online schooling so I've been a bit preoccupied. I have a new build for you today it runs on the new Unity 6.2 engine and has some optimization changes again, I'm moving up a major version number from 0.4.x to 0.5.x so make sure you see that in the corner to make sure you're on the latest build. In addition I have some AI tweaks to make enemy pathfinding and logic a bit smoother. I'm also actively working on getting the Rogue in and enabled.   [/p][p][/p][p]Future plans: I'd like to get ability upgrades turned back on, I have them in the game I just need to balance things with them. Currently the progression of the game is just buy items but I'm looking at broadening that to have ability upgrades in addition. Also I'd like to rework a lot of the items to not just be super similar to level up  perks. These are all things on my todo next list.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for sticking with me and supporting my game while I do my best. I appreciate everyone.[/p]

notes.title: 0.4.17 - New DX12 Build
notes.notes:
Todays update brings new Unity 6.1 tech to the game. I have officially enabled DirectX 12 support, with fallback to DirectX 11. There should be a pretty decent graphics performance gain across the board as the new DX12 culling and optimization changes are pretty significant. 

Here's an example of some of the expected performance gains as detailed by Unity:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719105/1ccb01de998d0196acf287d6e0fe247f3a13990c.png[/img]

As always if you run into any bugs, or have any issues please contact me here, or on Discord. 

Thanks!

notes.title: 0.4.14 - More performance optimizations
notes.notes: Always optimizing! Todays update is more optimization across the board. I re-enabled the Ability and Item buttons on the main menu so you can see what abilities and items are available. Also fixed some logic on the main menu for opening and closing some windows that would sometimes overlap or remain up. I also added two legendary easter egg items for some fellow indie developers out there. Hillfort Games with his game Long Gone, and Madchirpy with his game Shroud of Gloom. Check 'em out on Twitch and here on Steam, make sure to wish list 'em as well!

notes.title: 0.4.13 - New Unity build and IL2CPP Optimization
notes.notes:
This is another optimization build. Latest x.41f build from Unity 6, with IL2CPP code generation on. Should see a decent performance boost across the board. If you see anything weird let me know.
Thanks again for supporting me!

notes.title: 0.4.12 - Performance Optimizations
notes.notes:
Tonights patch brings a handful of performance optimization changes across the board.

Enemy AI performance increases
Player Ability performance increases
URP Graphics and Shader performace increase
Physics collision performance increases

notes.title: 0.4.11 - Engine Optimizations / Fixes
notes.notes:
This is a new build on the new release of Unity 6. This addresses a few memory leaks in the Unity engine associated with line renderers, and some physics code. This should clear up the stuttering and issues that were being reported after playing for an hour or so. 

If anyone sees any other issues please let me know either here, or on Discord. Thanks!

notes.title: 0.4.10 - 16:10 UI Fix
notes.notes: Alva reported an issue with UI button / text problems, found out that I wasn't properly scaling for 16:10 resolutions. This build should fix that, if anyone sees any weird UI issues please post up a screenshot of the affected spot and what resolution you are on. Thanks!

notes.title: 0.4.9 - Achievement Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a few mage achievements that instead of saying "..... Mage ....." it said Archer. 
Fixed the Obsidian Hills timer achievements, they were off by one. You were getting the 10 minute achievement at 5 minutes, the 15 at 10, etc. This should be fixed now.

notes.title: 0.4.8 - Purchased Ability Removal Addition
notes.notes:
Had a nice idea from Munkleplays on the steam forums to have the ability to remove or unlearn an ability. I have the system in and tested, there may be a few edge case scenarios where something is weird but right now if you hold down LeftShift and Right Click an ability on the right side of the screen, it will unlearn that ability. You cannot unlearn your primary ability, but 2-6 are removable. Removing an ability does not give you anything in return, it just removes it so you can learn something else in that slot.

I'm looking for any bugs, idea, or feedback regarding this change. You can post here or on Discord. Thanks!

notes.title: 0.4.7 - UI Fixes for Main Menu
notes.notes:
This build has a few UI fixes, menus should close / hide properly when clicking certain buttons on the main menu now. 

Also fixed the game guide to use screen scaling instead of constant pixel sizing so the UI portion for the game guide should now properly scale with all resolutions up to 4k.

This build is also using the IL2CPP back end in Unity 6, seeing if this helps with some GC issues that might be causing a jitter / framerate stutter on level 2.

notes.title: 0.4.5 - Level Geometry Fix (Character getting stuck)
notes.notes: Todays patch is pretty small but its a pretty big fix at the same time. I finally found the issue where the player would sometimes get stuck when moving around and nothing was in their way. This should fix all of that, if you keep seeing it please report it with a screenshot of what it looked like when you stopped moving.

notes.title: 0.4.3 - Game Guide
notes.notes:
After talking to a handful of people and watching others play the game I thought I'd create an in game guide system that details what a lot of things do. There a dozen or so categories and I've got them all setup with a pretty good start. I'll be updating the entries over the next week or so as I can think of additional stuff. 

Also I'm making pretty good progress on the Endless Mode, so stay tuned for that.

Thanks again to everyone for the feedback and support!

notes.title: 0.4.2 - Achievements fix
notes.notes: This update has a small fix to award achievements as they're awarded directly to Steam. I had the code wrong and it was only awarding them to Steam once you entered a level after having unlocked the achievement.

notes.title: 0.4.0 - Achievements!
notes.notes:
[h2]The achievement update is here![/h2]

You've been asking for it and here it is! (Thanks for keeping me motivated Marcus1503YT!). I have been storing some achievements behind the scenes in the game before now, but it was a limited set of around 12 achievements. As of this update I have a total of 84 Steam side achievements. I do not have any achievements for the new levels (Glacial and Burning) or the new classes (Rogue and Cleric) yet.

Steam has a hard limit of 100 achievements until your game has sold a relatively high amount of copies so I'm trying to hold those 16 open for other ideas I'll have for the content that's in the game currently. If you guys want more achievement slots tell your friend, stream the game, post videos to youtube, etc and lets get noticed and have Steam upgrade us to unlimited achievements. I have hundreds more I'd like to add in for the new classes, new endless mode, new levels, abilities, items, you name it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719105/097930a5fffc1d4e563530275ea088ae86d1a7a2.png[/img]

The first time you load into a level the game will attempt to restore any previously obtained achievements from the pool I had in so you may see a burst of achievements pop up the first time you launch this update. I have tested things pretty well but if you see any achievements that don't register or are unobtainable please let me know. 

Thanks everyone!

Strom

notes.title: 0.3.36 - Item / Meta balancing & Steam Integration (Achievements soon!)
notes.notes:
This update has a round of item balancing to try to bring some stats in line with being more balanced. A few meta upgrades were tuned as well. I know nobody likes things being nerfed but some values were a bit extreme. 

I also have Steamworks integration in this build as the precursor to the new Achievement update hopefully coming this week, barring any huge issues. Lots of folks have been asking for them and I've had them in game, they just didn't link up with Steam yet so you'll start to see achievements coming through to Steam after the Achievement update this week.

notes.title: 0.3.34 - New Abilities, minor changes and lots of fixes
notes.notes:
This is the latest development branch merged over to the release build. This has two new abilities, and the start of some ground based turret style attacks. We have a handful of fixes, and some tuning. There's a preview of two new classes that are being worked on, and a lot more stuff.

[list]
[*] New Ability: Ballista - Fires a large crossbow bolt that pierces through enemies.
[*] New Ability: Holy Spire - A ground totem that has three rotating beams of holy light
[*] New Rogue class preview added (Not currently playable)
[*] New Cleric class preview added (Not currently playable)
[*] You can rotate the character on the main menu now (left click and drag left or right to rotate)
[*] Fixed some null reference issues on some ability targetting
[*] Fixed a null reference error after killing the wave 15 final boss.
[*] Created three new items that speed up damage over time effects (Bleed, Burn, Poison)
[*] Fixed Loot Golem pathing, they shouldn't stick to the walls anymore
[/list]

notes.title: New Abilities and some Performance / Fixes coming soon
notes.notes:
I've been working with a few users on fixing some late game performance issues as well as improving performance when the game has been open for a few hours. I've also got two new abilities coming in the next patch this week. Ballista, and Holy Spire! This is the start of the new tech abilities that will be using the new Tech damage stat. Currently Ballista uses physical and Holy Spire uses magical but I'm going to swap them over once I get a few more turret/place-able abilities.

notes.title: 0.3.25 - Wall Fixes, Cost fixes, Loot Golem Pathfinding...
notes.notes:
Nothing huge in this patch, just a few collider issues, some typos, and some path finding tuning.

[list]
[*] Added some extra wall colliders on the Dwarven Crypt walls to help prevent dashing out of bounds.
[*] Fixed a handful of mis-typed entries for things like ability/item/meta upgrade costs.
[*] Fixed the pathfinding for the loot golem to be more sporadic and not always trying to find the outer edge of the level.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.24 - Minor fixes
notes.notes:
Just some small fixes in this patch. I had some reports of the Poison Kunai and Dagger ability stopping working after awhile, found an edge case that might be the issue so we'll see if that fixes it. Have had reports of no crashes and better performance after the last patch involving the extra enemies spawning outside of the level in rare cases so thats good news!


[list]
[*] Adjusted target acquisition code for all attacks, was an edge case where if something died while an ability was trying to get a target it could get a null key returned sometimes
[*] Re-enabled Luck echoes and luck items (More chances for Loot Golems!)
[*] Fixed an issue with player health regen was sometimes taking the player a fraction above full health and causing issues later with potion pickups
[/list]

Also thought it would be fun to put some animated shots of new enemies as I get them in. This is a clip from the Orc Ground slam unit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719105/3fb1cb65547b716bc5c95b1ecc2fd396be1889b3.gif[/img]

notes.title: 0.3.23 - Performance Fix, Loot Golems, Aegis of Flame, and more
notes.notes:
I found some edge cases where some enemies would spawn at/after the player died or when you quit to the main menu and they would stick around. These enemies should now be destroyed if that happens. I'm also purging and recreating the floating damage text pool in case that's also causing an issue.

Aegis of Flame has a new model for the orbiting parts. They can also block enemy projectiles now as well.

Oh and we have Loot Golems now. :) They have a small chance to spawn on each wave and drop coins and shards. The Luck stat affects how often they spawn as well.

Few other minor tweaks and changes.

[list]
[*] Fixed enemies sometimes spawning outside of the active scene, could cause some performance issues after awhile from them building up, added an extra cleanup pass
[*] Changed the GameController to reset the floating damage text object pool at the start of each map
[*] Changed the orbital objects on Aegis of Flame to have a shield model
[*] Aegis of Flame now blocks and destroys enemy projectiles
[*] Added glowing aura to healing potions, making them easier to see/find
[*] Fixed a sound issue with Holy Presence, it will only trigger once now
[*] Added a new Loot Golem enemy that has a chance to spawn on all waves. He currently drops coins and shards, I'll be adding more things for him to drop later.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719105/9c5253442d4248f31febfbd2de8ca2ad1dbc687f.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.3.06 - Max Enemy Casters Spawned Change
notes.notes:
Had reports of some extreme amounts of casters spawning, so I added in a maximum spawn counter for them, its currently set to 8.

The way the enemy spawn system works is a weighted list so normally they shouldn't build up but if they don't get killed I've seen dozens of casters all casting fireballs and its quite hard to deal with so I'm hoping this evens things out a bit. I can always bump that number up or remove it completely. 



I'm open to any thoughts/idea in regards to that.

notes.title: Survivors of Mayhem Early Access Launched!
notes.notes:
After over a year and a half of solo development I've launched Survivors of Mayhem.  I feel like its in a great place and very playable as it stands. I've got three levels, three characters, 26 abilities, hundreds of items, boons, orcs, goblins, ogres, trolls, skeletons, and more waiting for you to experience the game. I have tons of things I'm working on (check out the Early Access list of features) and I look forward to any and all feedback, thoughts, ideas, complaints, bugs, etc! 

My first plan of action is to flesh out some more enemy types this next week. So stay tuned for different and more challenging enemies!


Thank you for checking out my game!
Strom

notes.title: Early Access soon!
notes.notes:
I'm hoping to launch the Early Access version of the game here this week. Lots of things to do still but I feel like its at a great spot to get it out there for folks to try it out.


Strom
